---
title: Population-level genome-wide STR discovery and validation for population structure and genetic diversity assessment of Plasmodium species
author:
  - name: Jiru Han
    me: true
  - Jennifer E Munro
  - Andrew Kocoski
  - Andrew E Barry

abstract: |
  Short tandem repeats (STRs) are highly polymorphic genetic markers that can provide valuable information about population structure and genetic diversity. However, genome-wide STR discovery and validation at the population level have been limited in Plasmodium species. Here, we develop a population-level genome-wide STR discovery and validation framework for Plasmodium and assess the utility of STR variation for population structure and genetic diversity analyses.
